courses.title: Cybersecurity
courses.blurb: Defend systems, networks and data against modern threats.

lessons.title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
lessons.body: Learn the fundamentals of cybersecurity, why it is important, and the different types of cyber attacks that organizations face.

lessons.title: The CIA Triad
lessons.body: Understand the three core principles of information security: Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability.

lessons.title: Common Security Threats
lessons.body: Learn about malware, phishing, ransomware, brute force attacks and social engineering.

questions.prompt: What does CIA stand for in cybersecurity?
questions.explanation: The CIA Triad stands for Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability.

questions.prompt: Which attack tricks users into revealing sensitive information?
questions.explanation: Phishing attacks deceive users into sharing passwords or sensitive data.

lessons.title: Firewalls
lessons.body: Understand how firewalls monitor and filter incoming and outgoing network traffic.

lessons.title: VPN and Secure Communication
lessons.body: Learn how Virtual Private Networks encrypt internet traffic and protect user privacy.

lessons.title: Password Security
lessons.body: Learn how to create strong passwords and use multi-factor authentication.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of a firewall?
questions.explanation: Firewalls protect networks by filtering unauthorized traffic.

lessons.title: Ethical Hacking Basics
lessons.body: Learn how ethical hackers identify vulnerabilities to improve security.

lessons.title: Security Best Practices
lessons.body: Learn safe browsing, software updates, backups and least privilege principles.

lessons.title: Incident Response
lessons.body: Understand how organizations detect, respond to and recover from cyber incidents.

questions.prompt: Who performs authorized security testing on systems?
questions.explanation: Ethical hackers test systems with permission to improve security.

courses.title: Frontend Development
courses.blurb: Learn modern web development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.

lessons.title: Introduction to HTML
lessons.body: Learn the structure of HTML documents, tags, elements, attributes and how to build a basic web page.

lessons.title: Semantic HTML
lessons.body: Understand semantic elements like header, nav, main, section, article and footer to improve accessibility.

lessons.title: CSS Fundamentals
lessons.body: Learn selectors, colors, spacing, typography and Flexbox to style web pages.

questions.prompt: Which HTML element is used for the largest heading?
questions.explanation: The <h1> tag represents the highest level heading.

questions.prompt: Which CSS property changes text color?
questions.explanation: The color property changes the text color.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.body: Learn let, const, strings, numbers, booleans, arrays and objects.

lessons.title: Functions and ES6
lessons.body: Understand arrow functions, template literals, destructuring and spread operator.

lessons.title: DOM Manipulation
lessons.body: Learn how JavaScript interacts with HTML using the Document Object Model.

questions.prompt: Which keyword is used to declare a block scoped variable?
questions.explanation: Both let and const are block scoped.

lessons.title: Components
lessons.body: Learn functional components and reusable UI design.

lessons.title: Props and State
lessons.body: Understand how data flows through React applications.

lessons.title: React Hooks
lessons.body: Learn useState, useEffect and custom hooks.

questions.prompt: Which Hook is used to manage state?
questions.explanation: useState is the Hook used for component state.

courses.title: Data Analysis
courses.blurb: Analyze, visualize, and interpret data for better decision making.

lessons.title: Introduction to Data Analysis
lessons.body: Learn what data analysis is, why it is important, and how organizations use data to make better decisions.

lessons.title: Types of Data
lessons.body: Understand different types of data, including qualitative and quantitative data, and learn how they are used in analysis.

lessons.title: Data Collection and Preparation
lessons.body: Learn how data is collected, cleaned, organized and prepared before analysis.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of data analysis?
options: To extract useful insights from data
questions.explanation: The main purpose of data analysis is to examine data and extract useful information and insights for decision making.

lessons.title: Introduction to Data Visualization
lessons.body: Learn how visual representations such as charts and graphs can make data easier to understand and communicate.

lessons.title: Charts and Graphs
lessons.body: Learn when to use common charts and graphs such as bar charts, line charts and pie charts to represent data.

lessons.title: Creating Effective Visualizations
lessons.body: Understand how to choose appropriate visualizations, organize information clearly and communicate data insights effectively.

questions.prompt: Which visualization is commonly used to compare values across categories?
questions.explanation: Bar charts are commonly used to compare values across different categories.

lessons.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
lessons.body: Learn how exploratory data analysis helps identify patterns, trends, relationships and unusual values in datasets.

lessons.title: Interpreting Data
lessons.body: Learn how to interpret analytical results, identify meaningful patterns and turn findings into useful insights.

lessons.title: Business Insights and Reporting
lessons.body: Learn how to communicate analytical findings through reports and dashboards to support business decision making.

questions.prompt: What is an important goal of data analysis in business?
questions.explanation: Data analysis helps organizations understand information and make better evidence-based decisions.

courses.title: AI Automation
courses.blurb: Automate tasks and workflows using modern AI tools.

lessons.title: Introduction to AI Automation
lessons.body: Learn what AI automation is, how artificial intelligence can be combined with automation, and how automated workflows can reduce repetitive work.

lessons.title: AI Tools and Use Cases
lessons.body: Explore common AI tools and practical use cases such as content generation, customer support, data processing, research, and workflow automation.

lessons.title: Automation Workflow Basics
lessons.body: Understand triggers, actions, conditions, and outputs and learn how these elements work together to create automated workflows.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of AI automation?
options: To combine AI capabilities with automated workflows
questions.explanation: AI automation combines artificial intelligence with automated workflows to perform tasks efficiently with less manual effort.

lessons.title: Triggers and Actions
lessons.body: Learn how triggers start an automation and how actions define what happens after a workflow is triggered.

lessons.title: AI Prompts and Instructions
lessons.body: Learn how to write clear instructions for AI systems and understand how prompts influence the quality and usefulness of AI-generated results.

lessons.title: Connecting Apps and Services
lessons.body: Learn how different applications and services can be connected together to create useful automated workflows.

questions.prompt: What starts an automated workflow?
questions.explanation: A trigger is an event or condition that starts an automated workflow.

lessons.title: Automating Business Tasks
lessons.body: Learn how AI automation can be applied to repetitive business tasks such as email processing, customer support, document handling, and reporting.

lessons.title: Testing and Monitoring Automations
lessons.body: Learn how to test automated workflows, identify errors, monitor results, and improve workflow reliability.

lessons.title: Building a Complete AI Workflow
lessons.body: Combine triggers, actions, AI instructions, and connected services to design a complete AI-powered automation workflow.

questions.prompt: Why is testing important in AI automation?
options: To identify errors and improve reliability
To prevent users from accessing the system
questions.explanation: Testing helps identify errors and ensures that an automated workflow works correctly and reliably.

courses.title: UI/UX Design
courses.blurb: Design intuitive and user-friendly digital experiences.

lessons.title: Introduction to UI and UX
lessons.body: Learn the difference between User Interface and User Experience and understand how both areas work together to create useful and enjoyable digital products.

lessons.title: User-Centered Design
lessons.body: Learn how to design products around user needs, goals, behaviors, and problems. Understand why users should be considered throughout the design process.

lessons.title: Design Thinking Process
lessons.body: Explore the design thinking process and learn how empathy, problem definition, ideation, prototyping, and testing can be used to solve user problems.

questions.prompt: What does UX mainly focus on?
options: The user's overall experience with a product
questions.explanation: UX focuses on the user's overall experience, including usability, accessibility, interaction, and satisfaction.

lessons.title: Understanding User Research
lessons.body: Learn how user research helps designers understand user needs, behaviors, expectations, and problems before creating a product.

lessons.title: Personas and User Journeys
lessons.body: Learn how personas represent target users and how user journey maps help designers understand the steps, needs, and pain points users experience.

lessons.title: Wireframing and Information Architecture
lessons.body: Learn how wireframes communicate the structure of a digital product and how information architecture helps organize content and navigation.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of a wireframe?
options: To show the basic structure and layout of a page
To create a final marketing campaign
questions.explanation: A wireframe provides a basic visual representation of a page's structure, layout, and content organization.

lessons.title: UI Visual Design Principles
lessons.body: Learn fundamental visual design principles such as hierarchy, contrast, alignment, spacing, balance, and consistency.

lessons.title: Typography and Color
lessons.body: Learn how typography and color influence readability, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and the overall visual identity of a digital product.

lessons.title: Prototyping and Usability Testing
lessons.body: Learn how prototypes simulate product interactions and how usability testing helps identify problems and improve the user experience before development.

questions.prompt: Why is usability testing important?
options: It helps identify problems users experience
It removes the need for design
It is only used to choose colors
questions.explanation: Usability testing helps designers discover problems users experience and improve the product before final development.

courses.title: Digital Marketing
courses.blurb: Learn SEO, social media, and online marketing strategies.

lessons.title: Introduction to Digital Marketing
lessons.body: Learn the fundamentals of digital marketing and understand how businesses use digital channels to reach, engage, and convert their target audience.

lessons.title: Target Audience and Buyer Personas
lessons.body: Learn how to identify a target audience and create buyer personas based on customer needs, behaviors, goals, and challenges.

lessons.title: Digital Marketing Strategy
lessons.body: Learn how to create a basic digital marketing strategy by defining objectives, identifying audiences, selecting channels, and measuring results.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of digital marketing?
options: To reach and engage customers through digital channels
questions.explanation: Digital marketing uses digital channels to reach, engage, and convert a target audience.

lessons.title: Content Marketing Fundamentals
lessons.body: Learn how valuable and relevant content can attract a target audience, build trust, and support business goals.

lessons.title: Social Media Marketing
lessons.body: Learn how businesses use social media platforms to build awareness, engage audiences, distribute content, and develop relationships with customers.

lessons.title: Social Media Content Planning
lessons.body: Learn how to plan social media content using content themes, publishing schedules, audience insights, and measurable goals.

questions.prompt: What is an important goal of content marketing?
options: Creating useful and relevant content for an audience
questions.explanation: Content marketing focuses on creating and distributing valuable, relevant content to attract and engage a target audience.

lessons.title: Search Engine Optimization Basics
lessons.body: Learn the fundamentals of SEO and how search engines help users discover relevant websites and content.

lessons.title: Email Marketing
lessons.body: Learn how email marketing can be used to communicate with customers, nurture relationships, share useful content, and support conversions.

lessons.title: Marketing Analytics and Performance
lessons.body: Learn how to measure digital marketing performance using important metrics and use data to understand what is working and what needs improvement.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of marketing analytics?
options: To measure and understand marketing performance
questions.explanation: Marketing analytics helps measure campaign performance and provides data that can be used to improve marketing decisions.

courses.title: Project Management
courses.blurb: Plan, organize, and deliver successful projects.

lessons.title: Introduction to Project Management
lessons.body: Learn the fundamentals of project management and understand how projects are planned, organized, executed, monitored, and completed.

lessons.title: Project Life Cycle
lessons.body: Learn about the major stages of a project life cycle, from initiating and planning to executing, monitoring, controlling, and closing the project.

lessons.title: Project Goals and Scope
lessons.body: Learn how to define clear project goals, identify project requirements, and establish a project scope to keep the team focused on the expected outcomes.

questions.prompt: What is project management?
options: Applying knowledge, skills, tools, and techniques to project activities
questions.explanation: Project management involves applying knowledge, skills, tools, and techniques to project activities to meet project requirements.

lessons.title: Project Planning
lessons.body: Learn how to create a project plan by defining activities, timelines, resources, responsibilities, and expected deliverables.

lessons.title: Task Management and Scheduling
lessons.body: Learn how to break a project into manageable tasks, assign responsibilities, establish deadlines, and track progress using a project schedule.

lessons.title: Team Communication and Collaboration
lessons.body: Learn how effective communication, collaboration, responsibility sharing, and regular updates help project teams work efficiently toward common goals.

questions.prompt: Why is project planning important?
options: It removes the need for a project team
It helps define activities, responsibilities, resources, and timelines
It guarantees that no project changes will happen
questions.explanation: Project planning helps organize activities, responsibilities, resources, schedules, and expected outcomes before and during project execution.

lessons.title: Project Risk Management
lessons.body: Learn how to identify potential project risks, analyze their possible impact, and plan appropriate responses to reduce negative effects on project outcomes.

lessons.title: Monitoring Project Progress
lessons.body: Learn how project managers monitor progress, track deliverables, identify issues, and compare actual performance with the project plan.

lessons.title: Project Completion and Evaluation
lessons.body: Learn how to close a project, review deliverables, document lessons learned, evaluate project performance, and formally complete project activities.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of project risk management?
options: To eliminate every possible project change
To identify and respond to potential project risks
To avoid creating a project plan
questions.explanation: Risk management helps identify potential risks, understand their impact, and plan appropriate responses.

courses.title: Virtual Assistance
courses.blurb: Develop professional virtual assistant skills for remote work.

lessons.title: Introduction to Virtual Assistance
lessons.body: Learn the fundamentals of virtual assistance and understand the role, responsibilities, skills, and common services provided by virtual assistants.

lessons.title: Virtual Assistant Roles and Responsibilities
lessons.body: Learn about common virtual assistant responsibilities such as administrative support, communication, scheduling, research, data entry, and customer support.

lessons.title: Essential Virtual Assistant Skills
lessons.body: Learn the important skills required for successful virtual assistance, including communication, organization, time management, attention to detail, and digital tool usage.

questions.prompt: What is a virtual assistant?
options: A person who provides remote administrative or specialized support
questions.explanation: A virtual assistant provides remote administrative, technical, creative, or specialized support to clients or businesses.

lessons.title: Professional Communication
lessons.body: Learn how to communicate professionally with clients and team members using email, messaging platforms, video calls, and other digital communication tools.

lessons.title: Email and Calendar Management
lessons.body: Learn how virtual assistants organize emails, manage calendars, schedule appointments, set reminders, and coordinate meetings efficiently.

lessons.title: Data Entry and Online Research
lessons.body: Learn how to perform accurate data entry and conduct online research while organizing information clearly and verifying important details.

questions.prompt: Which skill is important when managing a client's calendar?
questions.explanation: Organization and attention to detail are essential for managing appointments, meetings, reminders, and scheduling changes.

lessons.title: Task and Time Management
lessons.body: Learn how to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, organize daily workloads, and use productivity techniques to complete client work efficiently.

lessons.title: Client Relationship Management
lessons.body: Learn how to build professional relationships with clients through clear communication, reliability, regular updates, and understanding client expectations.

lessons.title: Productivity Tools and Workflow
lessons.body: Learn how digital productivity and collaboration tools can help virtual assistants manage tasks, documents, communication, deadlines, and team workflows.

questions.prompt: Why is time management important for a virtual assistant?
options: It helps complete tasks efficiently and meet deadlines
It removes the need to communicate with clients
questions.explanation: Effective time management helps virtual assistants prioritize work, complete tasks efficiently, and meet client deadlines.
